a.lede: Cryptocurrency exchange Binance is investigating a potential security breach involving up to $5.8 billion in digital assets, in what could become the largest cryptocurrency hack in history. [...]
a.title: Binance probes potential $5.8 billion crypto-theft hack

b.lede: Hackers working for North Korea are suspected of hacking a Binance employee's laptop, which allowed the theft of billions in crypto.
b.title: North Korean hackers blamed for stealing record $6.3B in Binance breach
